name: dsh-desktop-tauri
description: Tauri desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness (dsh web)

scripts.lint: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked && node --test desktop-plugins/runtime-services/test/runtime-services.test.mjs desktop-plugins/settings/test/plugin-controls.test.mjs scripts/test-prune-plugin-client-dependencies.mjs && pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test-release-installer-isolation.ps1 && pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test-release-source.ps1 && pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test-release-gate-helpers.ps1
scripts.verify:payload: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example payload-tool -- verify --resources src-tauri/resources/payload
scripts.dev: npm run validate:icons && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.legacy.conf.json
scripts.build:legacy: npm run validate:icons && npm run stage:runtime && npm run verify:runtime && npm run stage:plugins && npm run verify:plugins && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.legacy.conf.json
